hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'wrangler deploy|wrangler publish'; then if grep -q 'REPLACE_WITH' worker/wrangler.toml 2>/dev/null; then echo '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "BLOQUE: wrangler.toml contient encore des valeurs placeholder (REPLACE_WITH). Remplace-les avant de deployer."}'; else echo '{"continue": true}'; fi; else echo '{"continue": true}'; fi
